title: Argent Flow / WILL Arcane / Antal / Liino
verificationNote: Prydwen Argent Flow Hyper: EXACT screenshot was not available for reinspection; order is a transcript from preceding discussion, not a directly fetched Prydwen Builder export. At (9.5) BS is Bolt Rush; at (11.5) BS is ordinary Darkness Cowed, as user explicitly settled. First combo -> 20s Bolt Rush vs 18/19s Combo cooldown yields narrow timing gate. 12 Arcane FS, 3 Liino Combo before Ult, Stagger-gated Finisher, final Nature IV is conditional own live-kit reconstruction. No measured 0→16 timing, no SP/UGE trace; all Arts/Physical checkpoints conditional/target, not observed. Link and source map in Games guide.
